passives.name: The Boy Who Dreamed of Becoming a Musician
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Does not take Weakness Gauge damage when the enemy has 150 or more Chain Points. Reduces damage taken from Fire, Water, and Earth enemies, and increases damage taken from Light and Dark enemies.

buffs.summary: −30% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
+15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
+45% damage to boss if attacker is Light
